ModMetaData.name: Reel's Facial Animation Textures
ModMetaData.author: Reel
ModMetaData.description:
My own Vanilla-Style textures for [NL] Facial Animations, built to work alongside Vanilla Expanded's retexture as well as EyeGenes2 to add custom eye coloring.
Adds 6 custom eye mouth textures that are based on Roblox faces. This mod doesn't add custom eyebrow or skin textures, however I may decide to add some in a future update.
Please place this above VTE Facial Anims and EyeGenes2.
